title: chore(liveness): bring `page` under the spec liveness gate
body:
Final follow-up to the Studio page-design dogfood. Brings the `page` metadata type under the codebase's own **spec liveness gate** (ADR-0049 / #1919) — the "declare every authorable property's status with evidence, or CI fails" ratchet. `page` was not yet a governed type.

## What
- New ledger `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` — all **17** top-level PageSchema properties classified (containers declared at one drill level, matching `action.json`):
  - **14 `live`** — objectui renderer consumers cited as prose in `note` (per the README convention for objectui-repo paths).
  - **1 `experimental`** — `variables` (PageVariablesProvider + usePageVariables exist, but no end-to-end writer/`visible`-CEL consumer).
  - **2 `dead`** — `recordReview` / `blankLayout`: their page types were removed in framework#2265 and objectui dropped all references in objectui#1949; the fields stay `@deprecated` pending hard-removal (tracked, enforce-or-remove).
- `page` added to `GOVERNED` in `check-liveness.mts`.

## Verification
- ✅ `check-liveness.mts` exits 0: *"page 17 classified (live 14, experimental 1, dead 2) … all governed-type properties are classified."*
- ✅ Adds **zero** new warnings vs the origin/main baseline (the 4 "missing file" + 5 "unregistered proof" warnings are all pre-existing on other types).
- ✅ Page schema tests 81/81.

## Follow-ups (noted, not in this PR)
- Hard-remove the `dead` `recordReview`/`blankLayout` fields + `BlankPageLayoutSchema`/`RecordReviewConfigSchema` + `page-builder.zod.ts` (now fully unblocked — objectui#1949 merged).
- Complete or remove `variables` (the `experimental` entry).
